avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction significantly reduces temsirolimus levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases temsirolimus levels and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative supplements and avoid grapefruit products

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 and reduce temsirolimus bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or monitor closely; consider alternatives for immune support

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 modulation; limited clinical data with temsirolimus
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and inform oncology team; monitor for efficacy changes

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.action: Permissible but use standard doses; monitor immunologic parameters

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and citrus products (pomelo, Seville orange)
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases temsirolimus plasma concentration and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and related citrus; use sweet oranges/lemons if needed

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May alter temsirolimus absorption kinetics; variable effects reported
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent meal timing; take with or without food consistently

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.action: Limit to minimal intake; discuss safe consumption limits with oncology team

monitoring_notes: Monitor for increased immunosuppression, hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia, and pneumonitis. Temsirolimus has significant CYP3A4 metabolism; assess all supplements and medications for enzyme interactions before initiation.
